70	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemo(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateMemoRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
71		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
72		if err != nil {
73			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
74		}
75		if user == nil {
76			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
77		}
78	
79		memoUID, err := ValidateAndGenerateUID(request.MemoId)
80		if err != nil {
81			return nil, err
82		}
83	
84		create := &store.Memo{
85			UID:        memoUID,
86			CreatorID:  user.ID,
87			Content:    request.Memo.Content,
88			Visibility: convertVisibilityToStore(request.Memo.Visibility),
89		}
90	
91		// Set custom timestamps if provided in the request.
92		if request.Memo.CreateTime != nil && request.Memo.CreateTime.IsValid() {
93			createdTs := request.Memo.CreateTime.AsTime().Unix()
94			create.CreatedTs = createdTs
95		}
96		if request.Memo.UpdateTime != nil && request.Memo.UpdateTime.IsValid() {
97			updatedTs := request.Memo.UpdateTime.AsTime().Unix()
98			create.UpdatedTs = updatedTs
99		}
100	
101		contentLengthLimit, err := s.getContentLengthLimit(ctx)
102		if err != nil {
103			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get content length limit")
104		}
105		if len(create.Content) > contentLengthLimit {
106			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "content too long (max %d characters)", contentLengthLimit)
107		}
108		if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
109			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to rebuild memo payload: %v", err)
110		}
111		if request.Memo.Location != nil {
112			create.Payload.Location = convertLocationToStore(request.Memo.Location)
113		}
114	
115		memo, err := s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)
116		if err != nil {
117			// Check for unique constraint violation (AIP-133 compliance)
118			errMsg := err.Error()
119			if strings.Contains(errMsg, "UNIQUE constraint failed") ||
120				strings.Contains(errMsg, "duplicate key") ||
121				strings.Contains(errMsg, "Duplicate entry") {
122				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "memo with ID %q already exists", memoUID)
123			}
124			return nil, err
125		}
126	
127		attachments := []*store.Attachment{}
128	
129		if len(request.Memo.Attachments) > 0 {
130			if err := s.setMemoAttachmentsInternal(ctx, user, memo, request.Memo.Attachments); err != nil {
131				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo attachments")
132			}
133	
134			a, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
135				MemoID: &memo.ID,
136			})
137			if err != nil {
138				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get memo attachments")
139			}
140			attachments = a
141		}
142		if len(request.Memo.Relations) > 0 {
143			if err := s.setMemoRelationsInternal(ctx, memo, request.Memo.Relations); err != nil {
144				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo relations")
145			}
146		}
147	
148		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
149		if err != nil {
150			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to load memo relations")
151		}
152		memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStore(ctx, memo, nil, attachments, relations)
153		if err != nil {
154			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo")
155		}
156		// Try to dispatch webhook when memo is created.
157		if err := s.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoMessage); err != nil {
158			slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo created webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
159		}
160	
161		// Broadcast live refresh event (skipped when called from CreateMemoComment).
162		if !isSSESuppressed(ctx) {
163			s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{
164				Type:       SSEEventMemoCreated,
165				Name:       memoMessage.Name,
166				Visibility: memo.Visibility,
167				CreatorID:  resolveSSECreatorID(memo, nil),
168			})
169		}
170	
171		if !isMentionNotificationSuppressed(ctx) {
172			s.dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort(ctx, memo, nil, "")
173		}
174	
175		return memoMessage, nil
176	}

178	func (s *APIV1Service) ListMemos(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListMemosRequest) (*v1pb.ListMemosResponse, error) {
179		memoFind := &store.FindMemo{
180			// Exclude comments by default.
181			ExcludeComments: true,
182		}
183		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
184		if err != nil {
185			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
186		}
187	
188		if request.State == v1pb.State_ARCHIVED {
189			state := store.Archived
190			memoFind.RowStatus = &state
191			// Archived memos are only visible to their creator.
192			if currentUser == nil {
193				return &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{}, nil
194			}
195			memoFind.CreatorID = &currentUser.ID
196		} else {
197			state := store.Normal
198			memoFind.RowStatus = &state
199		}
200	
201		// Parse order_by field (replaces the old sort and direction fields)
202		if request.OrderBy != "" {
203			if err := s.parseMemoOrderBy(request.OrderBy, memoFind); err != nil {
204				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid order_by: %v", err)
205			}
206		} else {
207			// Default ordering by create_time desc.
208			memoFind.OrderByTimeAsc = false
209		}
210	
211		if request.Filter != "" {
212			if err := s.validateFilter(ctx, request.Filter); err != nil {
213				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid filter: %v", err)
214			}
215			memoFind.Filters = append(memoFind.Filters, request.Filter)
216		}
217	
218		if currentUser == nil {
219			memoFind.VisibilityList = []store.Visibility{store.Public}
220		} else {
221			if memoFind.CreatorID == nil {
222				filter := fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
223				memoFind.Filters = append(memoFind.Filters, filter)
224			} else if *memoFind.CreatorID != currentUser.ID {
225				memoFind.VisibilityList = []store.Visibility{store.Public, store.Protected}
226			}
227		}
228	
229		var limit, offset int
230		if request.PageToken != "" {
231			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken
232			if err := unmarshalPageToken(request.PageToken, &pageToken); err != nil {
233				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token: %v", err)
234			}
235			limit = normalizePageSize(pageToken.Limit)
236			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
237		} else {
238			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
239		}
240		limit = min(limit, MaxPageSize)
241		limitPlusOne := limit + 1
242		memoFind.Limit = &limitPlusOne
243		memoFind.Offset = &offset
244		memos, err := s.Store.ListMemos(ctx, memoFind)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memos: %v", err)
247		}
248	
249		memoMessages := []*v1pb.Memo{}
250		nextPageToken := ""
251		if len(memos) == limitPlusOne {
252			memos = memos[:limit]
253			nextPageToken, err = getPageToken(limit, offset+limit)
254			if err != nil {
255				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token, error: %v", err)
256			}
257		}
258	
259		if len(memos) == 0 {
260			response := &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{
261				Memos:         memoMessages,
262				NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
263			}
264			return response, nil
265		}
266	
267		reactionMap := make(map[string][]*store.Reaction)
268		contentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(memos))
269	
270		attachmentMap := make(map[int32][]*store.Attachment)
271		memoIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos))
272	
273		for _, m := range memos {
274			contentIDs = append(contentIDs, fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, m.UID))
275			memoIDs = append(memoIDs, m.ID)
276		}
277	
278		// REACTIONS
279		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{ContentIDList: contentIDs})
280		if err != nil {
281			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")
282		}
283		for _, reaction := range reactions {
284			reactionMap[reaction.ContentID] = append(reactionMap[reaction.ContentID], reaction)
285		}
286	
287		// ATTACHMENTS
288		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{MemoIDList: memoIDs})
289		if err != nil {
290			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
291		}
292		for _, attachment := range attachments {
293			attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID] = append(attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID], attachment)
294		}
295	
296		// RELATIONS (batch load to avoid N+1)
297		relationMap, err := s.batchConvertMemoRelations(ctx, memos, false)
298		if err != nil {
299			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to batch load memo relations")
300		}
301		creatorIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos)+len(reactions))
302		for _, memo := range memos {
303			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, memo.CreatorID)
304		}
305		for _, reaction := range reactions {
306			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, reaction.CreatorID)
307		}
308		creatorMap, err := s.listUsersByID(ctx, creatorIDs)
309		if err != nil {
310			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo creators: %v", err)
311		}
312		for _, memo := range memos {
313			memoName := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memo.UID)
314			reactions := reactionMap[memoName]
315			attachments := attachmentMap[memo.ID]
316			relations := relationMap[memo.ID]

3	This package houses the memo-only filter engine that turns standard CEL syntax
4	into SQL fragments for the subset of expressions supported by the memo schema.
5	The engine follows a three phase pipeline inspired by systems
6	such as Calcite or Prisma:
7	
8	1. **Parsing** – CEL expressions are parsed with `cel-go` and validated against
9	   the memo-specific environment declared in `schema.go`. Only fields that
10	   exist in the schema can surface in the filter, and non-standard legacy
11	   coercions are rejected.
12	2. **Normalization** – the raw CEL AST is converted into an intermediate
13	   representation (IR) defined in `ir.go`. The IR is a dialect-agnostic tree of
14	   conditions (logical operators, comparisons, list membership, etc.). This
15	   step enforces schema rules (e.g. operator compatibility, type checks).
16	3. **Rendering** – the renderer in `render.go` walks the IR and produces a SQL
17	   fragment plus placeholder arguments tailored to a target dialect
18	   (`sqlite`, `mysql`, or `postgres`). Dialect differences such as JSON access,
19	   boolean semantics, placeholders, and `LIKE` vs `ILIKE` are encapsulated in
20	   renderer helpers.
21	
22	The entry point is `filter.DefaultEngine()` from `engine.go`. It lazily constructs
23	an `Engine` configured with the memo schema and exposes:
24	
25	```go
26	engine, _ := filter.DefaultEngine()
27	stmt, _ := engine.CompileToStatement(ctx, `has_task_list && visibility == "PUBLIC"`, filter.RenderOptions{
28		Dialect: filter.DialectPostgres,
29	})
30	// stmt.SQL  -> "((memo.payload->'property'->>'hasTaskList')::boolean IS TRUE AND memo.visibility = $1)"
31	// stmt.Args -> ["PUBLIC"]
32	```

34	## Core Files
35	
36	| File          | Responsibility                                                                  |
37	| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
38	| `schema.go`   | Declares memo fields, their types, backing columns, CEL environment options     |
39	| `ir.go`       | IR node definitions used across the pipeline                                    |
40	| `parser.go`   | Converts CEL `Expr` into IR while applying schema validation                    |
41	| `render.go`   | Translates IR into SQL, handling dialect-specific behavior                      |
42	| `engine.go`   | Glue between the phases; exposes `Compile`, `CompileToStatement`, and `DefaultEngine` |
43	| `helpers.go`  | Convenience helpers for store integration (appending conditions)                |
44	
45	## SQL Generation Notes
46	
47	- **Placeholders** — `?` is used for SQLite/MySQL, `$n` for Postgres. The renderer
48	  tracks offsets to compose queries with pre-existing arguments.
49	- **JSON Fields** — Memo metadata lives in `memo.payload`. The renderer handles
50	  `JSON_EXTRACT`/`json_extract`/`->`/`->>` variations and boolean coercion.
51	- **Time Fields** — `created_ts`, `updated_ts`, and attachment `create_time` are
52	  CEL `timestamp` values. Express instants with the `now` variable,
53	  `duration("…")` (e.g. `created_ts >= now - duration("24h")`), or
54	  `timestamp("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z")` / `timestamp(<epoch-seconds>)`. These fold
55	  to epoch seconds at compile time — `now` is frozen once per compile (injectable
56	  for tests via the engine clock) — so the backing columns stay unchanged.
57	- **Tag Operations** — `tag in [...]` and `"tag" in tags` become JSON array
58	  predicates. SQLite uses `LIKE` patterns, MySQL uses `JSON_CONTAINS`, and
59	  Postgres uses `@>`.
60	- **Boolean Flags** — Fields such as `has_task_list` render as `IS TRUE` equality
61	  checks, or comparisons against `CAST('true' AS JSON)` depending on the dialect.
62	- **String Matching** — `content.contains(x)`, `content.startsWith(x)`, and
63	  `content.endsWith(x)` render as case-insensitive `LIKE`/`ILIKE` with LIKE
64	  metacharacters (`%`, `_`, `\`) escaped. Available on scalar string fields whose
65	  schema sets `SupportsContains` (memo `content`; attachment `filename`,
66	  `mime_type`).
67	- **Regex** — `field.matches("pattern")` renders to `~` (Postgres) or `REGEXP`

72	  engine-specific patterns may not be portable.
73	- **Tag `all()` / `exists_one()`** — `tags.all(t, <pred>)` matches only non-empty
74	  tag sets where every element satisfies the predicate; `tags.exists_one(t,
75	  <pred>)` matches when exactly one element does (`COUNT(...) = 1`). Both iterate

88	  `sets.intersects(tags, [...])`, and `sets.equivalent(tags, [...])` desugar to

92	  other string fields) render to `LENGTH` / `CHAR_LENGTH` (MySQL) for code-point
93	  counts.
94	- **Arithmetic** — `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `%` constant-fold on literal/`now`/`duration`
95	  operands (division and modulo guard against a zero divisor).
96

39	func (s *APIV1Service) checkMemoReadAccess(ctx context.Context, memo *store.Memo) error {
40		if memo == nil {
41			return status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
42		}
43	
44		// Archived memos are only visible to their creator.
45		if memo.RowStatus == store.Archived {
46			user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
47			if err != nil {
48				return status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
49			}
50			if user == nil || memo.CreatorID != user.ID {
51				return status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
52			}
53		}
54	
55		if memo.Visibility != store.Public {
56			user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
57			if err != nil {
58				return status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
59			}
60			if user == nil {
61				return status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
62			}
63			if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID {
64				return status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
65			}
66		}
67		return nil
68	}

70	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemo(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateMemoRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
71		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
72		if err != nil {
73			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
74		}
75		if user == nil {
76			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
77		}
78	
79		memoUID, err := ValidateAndGenerateUID(request.MemoId)
80		if err != nil {
81			return nil, err
82		}
83	
84		create := &store.Memo{
85			UID:        memoUID,
86			CreatorID:  user.ID,
87			Content:    request.Memo.Content,
88			Visibility: convertVisibilityToStore(request.Memo.Visibility),
89		}
90	
91		// Set custom timestamps if provided in the request.
92		if request.Memo.CreateTime != nil && request.Memo.CreateTime.IsValid() {
93			createdTs := request.Memo.CreateTime.AsTime().Unix()
94			create.CreatedTs = createdTs
95		}
96		if request.Memo.UpdateTime != nil && request.Memo.UpdateTime.IsValid() {
97			updatedTs := request.Memo.UpdateTime.AsTime().Unix()
98			create.UpdatedTs = updatedTs
99		}
100	
101		contentLengthLimit, err := s.getContentLengthLimit(ctx)
102		if err != nil {
103			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get content length limit")
104		}
105		if len(create.Content) > contentLengthLimit {
106			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "content too long (max %d characters)", contentLengthLimit)
107		}
108		if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
109			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to rebuild memo payload: %v", err)
110		}
111		if request.Memo.Location != nil {
112			create.Payload.Location = convertLocationToStore(request.Memo.Location)
113		}
114	
115		memo, err := s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)
116		if err != nil {
117			// Check for unique constraint violation (AIP-133 compliance)
118			errMsg := err.Error()
119			if strings.Contains(errMsg, "UNIQUE constraint failed") ||
120				strings.Contains(errMsg, "duplicate key") ||
121				strings.Contains(errMsg, "Duplicate entry") {
122				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "memo with ID %q already exists", memoUID)
123			}
124			return nil, err
125		}
126	
127		attachments := []*store.Attachment{}
128	
129		if len(request.Memo.Attachments) > 0 {
130			if err := s.setMemoAttachmentsInternal(ctx, user, memo, request.Memo.Attachments); err != nil {
131				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo attachments")
132			}
133	
134			a, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
135				MemoID: &memo.ID,
136			})
137			if err != nil {
138				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get memo attachments")
139			}
140			attachments = a
141		}
142		if len(request.Memo.Relations) > 0 {
143			if err := s.setMemoRelationsInternal(ctx, memo, request.Memo.Relations); err != nil {
144				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo relations")
145			}
146		}
147	
148		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
149		if err != nil {
150			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to load memo relations")
151		}
152		memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStore(ctx, memo, nil, attachments, relations)
153		if err != nil {
154			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo")
155		}
156		// Try to dispatch webhook when memo is created.
157		if err := s.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoMessage); err != nil {
158			slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo created webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
159		}
160	
161		// Broadcast live refresh event (skipped when called from CreateMemoComment).
162		if !isSSESuppressed(ctx) {
163			s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{
164				Type:       SSEEventMemoCreated,
165				Name:       memoMessage.Name,
166				Visibility: memo.Visibility,
167				CreatorID:  resolveSSECreatorID(memo, nil),
168			})
169		}
170	
171		if !isMentionNotificationSuppressed(ctx) {
172			s.dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort(ctx, memo, nil, "")
173		}
174	
175		return memoMessage, nil
176	}

178	func (s *APIV1Service) ListMemos(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListMemosRequest) (*v1pb.ListMemosResponse, error) {
179		memoFind := &store.FindMemo{
180			// Exclude comments by default.
181			ExcludeComments: true,
182		}
183		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
184		if err != nil {
185			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
186		}
187	
188		if request.State == v1pb.State_ARCHIVED {
189			state := store.Archived
190			memoFind.RowStatus = &state
191			// Archived memos are only visible to their creator.
192			if currentUser == nil {
193				return &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{}, nil
194			}
195			memoFind.CreatorID = &currentUser.ID
196		} else {
197			state := store.Normal
198			memoFind.RowStatus = &state
199		}
200	
201		// Parse order_by field (replaces the old sort and direction fields)
202		if request.OrderBy != "" {
203			if err := s.parseMemoOrderBy(request.OrderBy, memoFind); err != nil {
204				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid order_by: %v", err)
205			}
206		} else {
207			// Default ordering by create_time desc.
208			memoFind.OrderByTimeAsc = false
209		}
210	
211		if request.Filter != "" {
212			if err := s.validateFilter(ctx, request.Filter); err != nil {
213				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid filter: %v", err)
214			}
215			memoFind.Filters = append(memoFind.Filters, request.Filter)
216		}
217	
218		if currentUser == nil {
219			memoFind.VisibilityList = []store.Visibility{store.Public}
220		} else {
221			if memoFind.CreatorID == nil {
222				filter := fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
223				memoFind.Filters = append(memoFind.Filters, filter)
224			} else if *memoFind.CreatorID != currentUser.ID {
225				memoFind.VisibilityList = []store.Visibility{store.Public, store.Protected}
226			}
227		}
228	
229		var limit, offset int
230		if request.PageToken != "" {
231			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken
232			if err := unmarshalPageToken(request.PageToken, &pageToken); err != nil {
233				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token: %v", err)
234			}
235			limit = normalizePageSize(pageToken.Limit)
236			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
237		} else {
238			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
239		}
240		limit = min(limit, MaxPageSize)
241		limitPlusOne := limit + 1
242		memoFind.Limit = &limitPlusOne
243		memoFind.Offset = &offset
244		memos, err := s.Store.ListMemos(ctx, memoFind)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memos: %v", err)
247		}
248	
249		memoMessages := []*v1pb.Memo{}
250		nextPageToken := ""
251		if len(memos) == limitPlusOne {
252			memos = memos[:limit]
253			nextPageToken, err = getPageToken(limit, offset+limit)
254			if err != nil {
255				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token, error: %v", err)
256			}
257		}
258	
259		if len(memos) == 0 {
260			response := &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{
261				Memos:         memoMessages,
262				NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
263			}
264			return response, nil
265		}
266	
267		reactionMap := make(map[string][]*store.Reaction)
268		contentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(memos))
269	
270		attachmentMap := make(map[int32][]*store.Attachment)
271		memoIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos))
272	
273		for _, m := range memos {
274			contentIDs = append(contentIDs, fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, m.UID))
275			memoIDs = append(memoIDs, m.ID)
276		}
277	
278		// REACTIONS
279		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{ContentIDList: contentIDs})
280		if err != nil {
281			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")
282		}
283		for _, reaction := range reactions {
284			reactionMap[reaction.ContentID] = append(reactionMap[reaction.ContentID], reaction)
285		}
286	
287		// ATTACHMENTS
288		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{MemoIDList: memoIDs})
289		if err != nil {
290			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
291		}
292		for _, attachment := range attachments {
293			attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID] = append(attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID], attachment)
294		}
295	
296		// RELATIONS (batch load to avoid N+1)
297		relationMap, err := s.batchConvertMemoRelations(ctx, memos, false)
298		if err != nil {
299			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to batch load memo relations")
300		}
301		creatorIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos)+len(reactions))
302		for _, memo := range memos {
303			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, memo.CreatorID)
304		}
305		for _, reaction := range reactions {
306			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, reaction.CreatorID)
307		}
308		creatorMap, err := s.listUsersByID(ctx, creatorIDs)
309		if err != nil {
310			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo creators: %v", err)
311		}
312		for _, memo := range memos {
313			memoName := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memo.UID)
314			reactions := reactionMap[memoName]
315			attachments := attachmentMap[memo.ID]
316			relations := relationMap[memo.ID]
317	
318			memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators(ctx, memo, reactions, attachments, relations, creatorMap)
319			if err != nil {
320				if stderrors.Is(err, errMemoCreatorNotFound) {
321					slog.Warn("Skipping memo with missing creator",
322						slog.Int64("memo_id", int64(memo.ID)),
323						slog.String("memo_uid", memo.UID),
324						slog.Int64("creator_id", int64(memo.CreatorID)),
325					)
326					continue
327				}
328				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo")
329			}
330	
331			memoMessages = append(memoMessages, memoMessage)
332		}
333	
334		response := &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{
335			Memos:         memoMessages,
336			NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
337		}
338		return response, nil
339	}

342		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)

376			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")

39	func (s *APIV1Service) checkMemoReadAccess(ctx context.Context, memo *store.Memo) error {
40		if memo == nil {
41			return status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
42		}
43	
44		// Archived memos are only visible to their creator.
45		if memo.RowStatus == store.Archived {
46			user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
47			if err != nil {
48				return status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
49			}
50			if user == nil || memo.CreatorID != user.ID {
51				return status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
52			}
53		}
54	
55		if memo.Visibility != store.Public {
56			user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
57			if err != nil {
58				return status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
59			}
60			if user == nil {
61				return status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
62			}
63			if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID {
64				return status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
65			}
66		}
67		return nil
68	}

70	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemo(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateMemoRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
71		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
72		if err != nil {
73			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
74		}
75		if user == nil {
76			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
77		}
78	
79		memoUID, err := ValidateAndGenerateUID(request.MemoId)
80		if err != nil {
81			return nil, err
82		}
83	
84		create := &store.Memo{
85			UID:        memoUID,
86			CreatorID:  user.ID,
87			Content:    request.Memo.Content,
88			Visibility: convertVisibilityToStore(request.Memo.Visibility),
89		}
90	
91		// Set custom timestamps if provided in the request.
92		if request.Memo.CreateTime != nil && request.Memo.CreateTime.IsValid() {
93			createdTs := request.Memo.CreateTime.AsTime().Unix()
94			create.CreatedTs = createdTs
95		}
96		if request.Memo.UpdateTime != nil && request.Memo.UpdateTime.IsValid() {
97			updatedTs := request.Memo.UpdateTime.AsTime().Unix()
98			create.UpdatedTs = updatedTs
99		}
100	
101		contentLengthLimit, err := s.getContentLengthLimit(ctx)
102		if err != nil {
103			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get content length limit")
104		}
105		if len(create.Content) > contentLengthLimit {
106			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "content too long (max %d characters)", contentLengthLimit)
107		}
108		if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
109			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to rebuild memo payload: %v", err)
110		}
111		if request.Memo.Location != nil {
112			create.Payload.Location = convertLocationToStore(request.Memo.Location)
113		}
114	
115		memo, err := s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)
116		if err != nil {
117			// Check for unique constraint violation (AIP-133 compliance)
118			errMsg := err.Error()
119			if strings.Contains(errMsg, "UNIQUE constraint failed") ||
120				strings.Contains(errMsg, "duplicate key") ||
121				strings.Contains(errMsg, "Duplicate entry") {
122				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "memo with ID %q already exists", memoUID)
123			}
124			return nil, err
125		}
126	
127		attachments := []*store.Attachment{}
128	
129		if len(request.Memo.Attachments) > 0 {
130			if err := s.setMemoAttachmentsInternal(ctx, user, memo, request.Memo.Attachments); err != nil {
131				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo attachments")
132			}
133	
134			a, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
135				MemoID: &memo.ID,
136			})
137			if err != nil {
138				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get memo attachments")
139			}
140			attachments = a
141		}
142		if len(request.Memo.Relations) > 0 {
143			if err := s.setMemoRelationsInternal(ctx, memo, request.Memo.Relations); err != nil {
144				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo relations")
145			}
146		}
147	
148		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
149		if err != nil {
150			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to load memo relations")
151		}
152		memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStore(ctx, memo, nil, attachments, relations)
153		if err != nil {
154			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo")
155		}
156		// Try to dispatch webhook when memo is created.
157		if err := s.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoMessage); err != nil {
158			slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo created webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
159		}
160	
161		// Broadcast live refresh event (skipped when called from CreateMemoComment).
162		if !isSSESuppressed(ctx) {
163			s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{
164				Type:       SSEEventMemoCreated,
165				Name:       memoMessage.Name,
166				Visibility: memo.Visibility,
167				CreatorID:  resolveSSECreatorID(memo, nil),
168			})
169		}
170	
171		if !isMentionNotificationSuppressed(ctx) {
172			s.dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort(ctx, memo, nil, "")
173		}
174	
175		return memoMessage, nil
176	}

178	func (s *APIV1Service) ListMemos(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListMemosRequest) (*v1pb.ListMemosResponse, error) {
179		memoFind := &store.FindMemo{
180			// Exclude comments by default.
181			ExcludeComments: true,
182		}
183		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
184		if err != nil {
185			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
186		}
187	
188		if request.State == v1pb.State_ARCHIVED {
189			state := store.Archived
190			memoFind.RowStatus = &state
191			// Archived memos are only visible to their creator.
192			if currentUser == nil {
193				return &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{}, nil
194			}
195			memoFind.CreatorID = &currentUser.ID
196		} else {
197			state := store.Normal
198			memoFind.RowStatus = &state
199		}
200	
201		// Parse order_by field (replaces the old sort and direction fields)
202		if request.OrderBy != "" {
203			if err := s.parseMemoOrderBy(request.OrderBy, memoFind); err != nil {
204				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid order_by: %v", err)
205			}
206		} else {
207			// Default ordering by create_time desc.
208			memoFind.OrderByTimeAsc = false
209		}
210	
211		if request.Filter != "" {
212			if err := s.validateFilter(ctx, request.Filter); err != nil {
213				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid filter: %v", err)
214			}
215			memoFind.Filters = append(memoFind.Filters, request.Filter)
216		}
217	
218		if currentUser == nil {
219			memoFind.VisibilityList = []store.Visibility{store.Public}
220		} else {
221			if memoFind.CreatorID == nil {
222				filter := fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
223				memoFind.Filters = append(memoFind.Filters, filter)
224			} else if *memoFind.CreatorID != currentUser.ID {
225				memoFind.VisibilityList = []store.Visibility{store.Public, store.Protected}
226			}
227		}
228	
229		var limit, offset int
230		if request.PageToken != "" {
231			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken
232			if err := unmarshalPageToken(request.PageToken, &pageToken); err != nil {
233				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token: %v", err)
234			}
235			limit = normalizePageSize(pageToken.Limit)
236			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
237		} else {
238			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
239		}
240		limit = min(limit, MaxPageSize)
241		limitPlusOne := limit + 1
242		memoFind.Limit = &limitPlusOne
243		memoFind.Offset = &offset
244		memos, err := s.Store.ListMemos(ctx, memoFind)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memos: %v", err)
247		}
248	
249		memoMessages := []*v1pb.Memo{}
250		nextPageToken := ""
251		if len(memos) == limitPlusOne {
252			memos = memos[:limit]
253			nextPageToken, err = getPageToken(limit, offset+limit)
254			if err != nil {
255				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token, error: %v", err)
256			}
257		}
258	
259		if len(memos) == 0 {
260			response := &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{
261				Memos:         memoMessages,
262				NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
263			}
264			return response, nil
265		}
266	
267		reactionMap := make(map[string][]*store.Reaction)
268		contentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(memos))
269	
270		attachmentMap := make(map[int32][]*store.Attachment)
271		memoIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos))
272	
273		for _, m := range memos {
274			contentIDs = append(contentIDs, fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, m.UID))
275			memoIDs = append(memoIDs, m.ID)
276		}
277	
278		// REACTIONS
279		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{ContentIDList: contentIDs})
280		if err != nil {
281			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")
282		}
283		for _, reaction := range reactions {
284			reactionMap[reaction.ContentID] = append(reactionMap[reaction.ContentID], reaction)
285		}
286	
287		// ATTACHMENTS
288		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{MemoIDList: memoIDs})
289		if err != nil {
290			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
291		}
292		for _, attachment := range attachments {
293			attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID] = append(attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID], attachment)
294		}
295	
296		// RELATIONS (batch load to avoid N+1)
297		relationMap, err := s.batchConvertMemoRelations(ctx, memos, false)
298		if err != nil {
299			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to batch load memo relations")
300		}
301		creatorIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos)+len(reactions))
302		for _, memo := range memos {
303			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, memo.CreatorID)
304		}
305		for _, reaction := range reactions {
306			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, reaction.CreatorID)
307		}
308		creatorMap, err := s.listUsersByID(ctx, creatorIDs)
309		if err != nil {
310			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo creators: %v", err)
311		}
312		for _, memo := range memos {
313			memoName := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memo.UID)
314			reactions := reactionMap[memoName]
315			attachments := attachmentMap[memo.ID]
316			relations := relationMap[memo.ID]

323						slog.String("memo_uid", memo.UID),
324						slog.Int64("creator_id", int64(memo.CreatorID)),
325					)
326					continue

328				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo")
329			}

333	
334		response := &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{

336			NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
337		}

## Report: Database Tables Affected by DeleteMemo

Based on my thorough analysis of the DeleteMemo flow, here are all the tables that are deleted from or modified when DeleteMemo runs:

### Tables Deleted or Modified (in order of execution):

1. **memo_relation** (DELETED)
   - First deletion: Records where `memo_id = deleted_memo_id` (relations where the memo is the source)
   - Second deletion: Records where `related_memo_id = deleted_memo_id` (relations where the memo is the target)

2. **attachment** (DELETED)
   - All attachments linked to the memo are deleted
   - For each attachment, DeleteAttachment is called which:
     - Deletes the physical storage (local files or S3 objects)
     - Deletes the attachment row from the attachment table

3. **memo** (DELETED)
   - The memo record itself is deleted from the memo table
   - This happens AFTER memo_relation and attachment cleanup

4. **memo_share** (DELETED via CASCADE)
   - PostgreSQL and MySQL have `ON DELETE CASCADE` foreign key constraint
   - SQLite has `ON DELETE CASCADE` foreign key constraint
   - All memo_share records referencing the deleted memo are automatically deleted

### Tables NOT Explicitly Cleaned Up:

- **reaction** - Reactions linked to the memo (via content_id matching the memo name) are NOT deleted. These orphaned records remain in the database.
- **inbox** - No automatic cleanup occurs for inbox entries
- **user**, **user_setting**, **idp**, **system_setting**, **user_identity** - Not affected

### Special Case: Memo Comments

Before the main memo is deleted, all comments (which are themselves memos) linked to it are deleted recursively:
- Finds all memo_relation records where the deleted memo's ID is the `related_memo_id` with type='COMMENT'
- For each comment memo, calls `Store.DeleteMemo()` recursively
- This ensures comment memos and their related attachments/relations are cleaned up first

### Summary of Deletion Order:

1. memo_relation (as source)
2. memo_relation (as target)
3. attachment (and associated storage files)
4. memo (the memo itself)
5. memo_share (via CASCADE if DB supports it)
6. (Recursively handles comments before main memo deletion)

## Report: Frontend Serving Mechanism

**Mechanism Name:** go:embed with Echo Static Middleware and SPA Fallback Handler

**Configuration File Path:** `/bench/home/work/server/router/frontend/frontend.go`

**Secondary Reference:** `/bench/home/work/server/server.go` (line 72)

### How it Works:

1. **Embedded Files:** The compiled React frontend is embedded directly into the Go binary using the `//go:embed dist/*` directive (line 20 in frontend.go). This embeds all files from `/bench/home/work/server/router/frontend/dist/` into the binary.

2. **File System Access:** The `embeddedFiles` variable (type `embed.FS`) is accessed via `getFileSystem("dist")` function (line 115-121) which returns a subset of the embedded filesystem pointing to the `dist` directory.

3. **Serving Mechanism:** The frontend service uses Echo's middleware to serve static files:
   - **Primary Handler:** `middleware.StaticWithConfig()` (line 54-57) serves static assets directly from the embedded filesystem
   - **Skipper Function:** Routes like `/api/*`, `/file/*`, `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, and gRPC endpoints bypass static serving
   - **SPA Fallback:** `spaFallbackMiddleware()` (line 63-79) catches 404 errors and serves `index.html` for client-side routing

4. **Cache Control Headers:** Intelligent cache headers are set:
   - HTML files: `no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate`
   - Static assets in `/assets/`: `public, max-age=3600, immutable` (hashed filenames)
   - Other assets: `public, max-age=3600`

5. **Initialization Chain:**
   - `main.go` creates server instance
   - `server.go` line 72 calls `frontend.NewFrontendService().Serve()`
   - FrontendService.Serve() registers Echo middleware for static file serving

**Key Code Section (frontend.go, lines 20-21):**
```go
//go:embed dist/*
var embeddedFiles embed.FS
```

This ensures the entire compiled React build output is baked into the production Go binary, eliminating the need for external static file serving or complex deployment configurations.</result>

196			}
197		} else {
198			fmt.Printf("Server running on unix socket: %s\n", profile.UNIXSock)
199		}

101	func (s *Server) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
102		var address, network string
103		if len(s.Profile.UNIXSock) == 0 {
104			address = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", s.Profile.Addr, s.Profile.Port)
105			network = "tcp"
106		} else {
107			address = s.Profile.UNIXSock
108			network = "unix"
109		}
110		listener, err := net.Listen(network, address)
111		if err != nil {
112			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to listen")
113		}
114	
115		if network == "unix" {
116			if err := os.Chmod(address, 0660); err != nil {
117				_ = listener.Close()
118				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to chmod socket")
119			}
120		}
121	
122		// Start Echo server directly (no cmux needed - all traffic is HTTP).
123		s.httpServer = &http.Server{Handler: s.echoServer}
124		go func() {
125			if err := s.httpServer.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
126				slog.Error("failed to start echo server", "error", err)
127			}
128		}()
129		s.startBackgroundRunners(ctx)
130	
131		return nil
132	}

184	func (s *Server) waitBackgroundRunners(ctx context.Context) {
185		done := make(chan struct{})

188			close(done)

195			case <-done:
196				return
197			default:
198			}
199			slog.Error("failed to stop background runners", slog.String("error", ctx.Err().Error()))
200		}
201	}

44	func NewServer(ctx context.Context, profile *profile.Profile, store *store.Store) (*Server, error) {
45		s := &Server{
46			Store:   store,
47			Profile: profile,
48		}
49	
50		echoServer := echo.New()
51		echoServer.Use(middleware.Recover())
52		echoServer.Use(newCORSMiddleware(profile))
53		s.echoServer = echoServer
54	
55		instanceBasicSetting, err := s.getOrUpsertInstanceBasicSetting(ctx)
56		if err != nil {
57			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get instance basic setting")
58		}
59	
60		secret := "usememos"
61		if !profile.Demo {
62			secret = instanceBasicSetting.SecretKey
63		}
64		s.Secret = secret
65	
66		// Register healthz endpoint.
67		echoServer.GET("/healthz", func(c *echo.Context) error {
68			return c.String(http.StatusOK, "Service ready.")
69		})
70	
71		// Serve frontend static files.
72		frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)
73	
74		rootGroup := echoServer.Group("")
75	
76		apiV1Service := apiv1.NewAPIV1Service(s.Secret, profile, store)
77		s.sseHub = apiV1Service.SSEHub
78	
79		// Register HTTP file server routes BEFORE gRPC-Gateway to ensure proper range request handling for Safari.
80		// This uses native HTTP serving (http.ServeContent) instead of gRPC for video/audio files.
81		fileServerService := fileserver.NewFileServerService(s.Profile, s.Store, s.Secret)
82		fileServerService.RegisterRoutes(echoServer)
83	
84		// Create and register RSS routes (needs markdown service from apiV1Service).
85		rss.NewRSSService(s.Profile, s.Store, apiV1Service.MarkdownService).RegisterRoutes(rootGroup)
86	
87		// Register gRPC gateway as api v1 (includes SSE endpoint on CORS-enabled group).
88		if err := apiV1Service.RegisterGateway(ctx, echoServer); err != nil {
89			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to register gRPC gateway")
90		}
91	
92		mcpService, err := mcp.NewMCPService(profile, echoServer)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create MCP service")
95		}
96		mcpService.RegisterRoutes(echoServer)
97	
98		return s, nil
99	}

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/pkg/errors"
)

// Scheduler manages scheduled jobs.
type Scheduler struct {
	jobs       map[string]*registeredJob
	jobsMu     sync.RWMutex
	timezone   *time.Location
	middleware Middleware
	running    bool
	runningMu  sync.RWMutex
	stopCh     chan struct{}
	wg         sync.WaitGroup
}

// registeredJob wraps a Job with runtime state.
type registeredJob struct {
	job      *Job
	cancelFn context.CancelFunc
}

// Option configures a Scheduler.
type Option func(*Scheduler)

// WithTimezone sets the default timezone for all jobs.
func WithTimezone(tz string) Option {
	return func(s *Scheduler) {
		loc, err := time.LoadLocation(tz)
		if err != nil {
			// Default to UTC on invalid timezone
			loc = time.UTC
		}
		s.timezone = loc
	}
}

// WithMiddleware sets middleware to wrap all job handlers.
func WithMiddleware(mw ...Middleware) Option {
	return func(s *Scheduler) {
		if len(mw) > 0 {
			s.middleware = Chain(mw...)
		}
	}
}

// New creates a new Scheduler with optional configuration.
func New(opts ...Option) *Scheduler {
	s := &Scheduler{
		jobs:     make(map[string]*registeredJob),
		timezone: time.UTC,
		stopCh:   make(chan struct{}),
	}

	for _, opt := range opts {
		opt(s)
	}

	return s
}

// Register adds a job to the scheduler.
// Jobs must be registered before calling Start().
func (s *Scheduler) Register(job *Job) error {
	if job == nil {
		return errors.New("job cannot be nil")
	}

	if err := job.Validate(); err != nil {
		return errors.Wrap(err, "invalid job")
	}

	s.jobsMu.Lock()
	defer s.jobsMu.Unlock()

	if _, exists := s.jobs[job.Name]; exists {
		return errors.Errorf("job with name %q already registered", job.Name)
	}

	s.jobs[job.Name] = &registeredJob{job: job}
	return nil
}

// Start begins executing scheduled jobs.
func (s *Scheduler) Start() error {
	s.runningMu.Lock()
	defer s.runningMu.Unlock()

	if s.running {
		return errors.New("scheduler already running")
	}

	s.jobsMu.RLock()
	defer s.jobsMu.RUnlock()

	// Parse and schedule all jobs
	for _, rj := range s.jobs {
		schedule, err := ParseCronExpression(rj.job.Schedule)
		if err != nil {
			return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to parse schedule for job %q", rj.job.Name)
		}

		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		rj.cancelFn = cancel

		s.wg.Add(1)
		go s.runJobWithSchedule(ctx, rj, schedule)
	}

	s.running = true
	return nil
}

// runJobWithSchedule executes a job according to its cron schedule.
func (s *Scheduler) runJobWithSchedule(ctx context.Context, rj *registeredJob, schedule *Schedule) {
	defer s.wg.Done()

	// Apply middleware to handler
	handler := rj.job.Handler
	if s.middleware != nil {
		handler = s.middleware(handler)
	}

		now := time.Now()
		if rj.job.Timezone != "" {
			loc, err := time.LoadLocation(rj.job.Timezone)
			if err == nil {
				now = now.In(loc)
			}
		} else if s.timezone != nil {
			now = now.In(s.timezone)
		}

		next := schedule.Next(now)
